name: Tata Electronics semiconductor assembly and test facility, Jagiroad

parties.name: Government of India
parties.note: Approved the unit in February 2024 together with two other semiconductor projects.

parties.name: Government of Assam
parties.note: State government represented at the foundation stone ceremony in Jagiroad.

summary: Tata Electronics' greenfield, high-volume chip assembly and test plant at Jagiroad in Morigaon district, Assam, near Guwahati. The Union Cabinet approved the INR 27,000 crore unit in February 2024 and the foundation stone was laid in March 2024. The plant is to offer wire bond, flip chip and integrated systems packaging for automotive, communications, computing and AI customers. Tata now puts the investment at USD 3 billion (more than USD 3 billion on its facility page) on a 171-acre campus and still described the plant as being built in September 2026. In October 2026 the state's chief minister said the first cleanroom was ready and pilot chips were being made, with a formal inauguration expected around the turn of the year.
